item.tib: ma mo yang snying 'dus rgyud las bsad pa brnag pa'i dbal 'khor
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan bde chen gling pa'am/ rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyis gyim shod zangs brag rin chen 'bar ba nas sa lug zla ba'i tshes bzang por gter du spyan drangs nas slar chu khyi rbo (dbo) zla'i phyogs phyi mar brda ris bcos slad med par phab nas yi ge pa ni g.yung drung dar rgyas can gyis byas pa'i dge tshogs yongs la khyab par shog/
